selected.rationale: The Affluent Classic has a low price sensitivity and an affinity for classic apparel and home goods with a typical AOV of $145, matching the luxury price tier and $1,200 average price point of the Florence-made leather handbags. Her messaging preferences for craftsmanship and heritage align directly with the advertiser's values of craftsmanship and aesthetic.

The Sustainability Buyer researches supply chains and is willing to pay more for genuinely sustainable and well-crafted options. This connects directly to the advertiser's handcrafted in Florence, custom-fit leather goods model, which emphasizes artisanal production over mass manufacturing.

The Gifter looks for impressive-looking purchases with a higher AOV and responds to premium presentation and giftable messaging. Custom-fit Italian leather handbags priced at $1,200 serve as an ideal high-end gift item for milestone occasions.

rejected.reason: The Wellness Optimizer focuses on health, fitness, supplements, and clean beauty with science-backed claims, which does not align with luxury fashion accessories and apparel.

The Busy Parent explicitly lists a disinterest in luxury positioning and prefers convenience and subscriptions, whereas the advertiser offers one-off custom luxury leather handbags with a 6-week shipping window.
The Gen Z Aesthete has a typical AOV of $48 and medium-high price sensitivity, making them an unrealistic buyer for a $1,200 luxury handbag.
The Pet Parent focuses entirely on pet food, supplies, health, and subscription boxes, which has no overlap with luxury leather handbags.

The Convenience-First Millennial prioritizes speed, instant delivery, and low brand loyalty if fulfillment is delayed, whereas the advertiser requires a 6-week minimum order shipping window for custom-made items.
The Value-Conscious Shopper has high price sensitivity and looks for discounts, bundles, and first-order deals, which conflicts with the $1,200 luxury price point.
The Fitness Enthusiast focuses on activewear, supplements, and recovery products with performance claims, which does not relate to luxury leather goods.
